info.title: ReleaseTwin CLI
info.description: Release-proof testing for integration-heavy, feature-flagged systems: evidence-linked cases, immutable fixtures, and paired known-bad/known-good "flag proof". Runs entirely in your own infrastructure; exits non-zero on any case failure so it drops into CI as a required check. UI-journey cases additionally need `playwright install`.

options.name: --summary-json
options.description:
also write a machine-readable JSON run summary
(or set RELEASETWIN_SUMMARY_JSON)

options.name: --junit-xml
options.description:
also write a JUnit XML test report for CI test
widgets (or set RELEASETWIN_JUNIT_XML)
`releasetwin <dir>` and `releasetwin --journey <id>@<v>` still work without `run`.
